# Gus Portal - LLM Instructions

> React Native 0.76 + Expo 52 mobile app (Android, iOS, Web)

## Quick Access

**Main Instructions**: AI_INSTRUCTIONS.md
**Platform Rules**: docs/ENVIRONMENTS.md (READ FIRST - critical for cross-platform compatibility)
**Stack Reference**: docs/LLM_CONTEXT.md
**Testing Config**: ai.config.yml

## Critical Rule

This is a CROSS-PLATFORM mobile app. Never use:
- Web APIs (window, document, localStorage)
- HTML elements (div, button, span)
- Web-only npm packages

Always use React Native components (View, Text, TouchableOpacity) and Expo APIs.

## Skills Available

- skills/rn-test-generator/ - Generate Jest/RNTL tests
- skills/rn-platform-validation/ - Validate platform compatibility
- skills/rn-security/ - Security best practices

## Dev Commands

npm start          # Metro bundler
npm test           # Run tests
npm run android    # Android build
npm run ios        # iOS build
npm run web        # Web build

---

For complete instructions, see AI_INSTRUCTIONS.md
